answer: The relic that can be looked up, the dawn that can be counted, and the gale that can be challenged: nothing more is needed. Before any reward, the agent must show True paviour commission with paviours attestation — a commission paviours renew after stone audits. The price is time: 4 years and 150 stone audits per identity, and time is the one thing a farm cannot print. The farm cannot afford all three.
